title: Current calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly apply Ohm's law to find current I = E/(R₀ + r) = 1.5 A.

title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Student must compute F_a = BIL = 0.30 N using the correct current and given values.

title: Gravity decomposition
description: Important: Student must resolve gravity into components, finding F₁ = mg sinθ = 0.24 N along the incline.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: Student must set up correct equilibrium equation along incline, considering directions of Ampere force, gravity component, and friction.

title: Friction calculation
description: Essential: Student must solve equilibrium to find friction f = F_a - mg sinθ = 0.06 N.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and includes units with final answers.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns direction/sign to forces (e.g., friction opposite to actual direction, wrong sign in equilibrium).

title: Ohm's law misuse
description: Pitfall: Student omits internal resistance or uses wrong resistance in current calculation (e.g., I = E/R₀ only).
